company.description:
Orfinex Capital is a financial technology and online trading company specializing in foreign exchange (Forex) and Contracts for Differences (CFD) markets. Established in 2015, the company provides trading services for retail and institutional clients seeking exposure to currencies, commodities, indices, and equities through leveraged financial instruments. Its platform integrates market analysis tools, real-time charting capabilities, and trading infrastructure designed to support both beginner and experienced traders.

The company’s business model is based primarily on spreads, commissions, and trading-related fees generated from client transactions executed on its platform. Orfinex offers access to multiple asset classes, including major forex pairs, precious metals, energy products, stock CFDs, and shares linked to global companies such as Amazon, Netflix, and Tesla. The platform also incorporates TradingView-powered charting tools, economic calendars, and trader communication features to enhance market analysis and user engagement.

A distinguishing component of Orfinex’s offering is its Direct Funding Program, which enables qualified traders to access company-funded trading capital. Under this model, traders can manage allocated funds and receive a share of generated profits, creating an additional revenue and talent acquisition channel for the company. This proprietary trading-style structure is designed to attract skilled market participants while expanding trading activity on the platform.

Orfinex positions itself as a globally oriented broker with a focus on technology-driven trading solutions, customer support, and market accessibility. The company has also promoted industry awards and regional recognition in Asia and the Middle East as part of its branding and credibility strategy within the competitive online brokerage sector.
